title: GreenLLM: SLO-Aware Dynamic Frequency Scaling for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving
technique: phase-specific GPU DVFS: length-based prompt queues, queueing-aware prefill frequency optimization, dual-loop decode controller tracking TPS and P95 TBT

optimized_metrics.evidence: We introduce GreenLLM, a service-level objectives (SLO) aware serving framework that minimizes GPU energy by explicitly separating prefill and decode control.
SLOs target TTFT < 400ms for Short/Medium prompts, < 2s for Long, and P95 TBT <= 100ms during decode
optimized_metrics.stat_quote: SLOs target TTFT < 400ms for Short/Medium prompts, < 2s for Long

optimized_metrics.evidence: track the target TBT (100 ms P95) and conserve energy by reducing the frequency whenever possible
optimized_metrics.stat_quote: track the target TBT (100 ms P95)

headline_claim.text: GreenLLM achieves up to 34% reduction in total energy consumption compared to the default DVFS baseline in Alibaba/Azure trace replays, with no loss of throughput and only less than 3.5% SLO violations increase

metric_definitions.definition_quote: the service often has a target time between tokens (TBT) to keep the output responsive
metric_definitions.notes: not formally defined; used as sliding-window P95 over recent tokens, recomputed every 20 ms

metric_definitions.definition_quote: ∼ O(n^2) in prompt length; it largely determines TTFT.
metric_definitions.notes: TTFT never formally defined; slack analysis says SLO violations 'due to queueing delays rather than processing time' so queueing is included; per-length-class SLO

metric_definitions.definition_quote: maintains P95 TBT below 100 ms and minimizes energy per token (i.e., power/TPS)
metric_definitions.notes: decode objective; prefill objective is total energy within the SLO window including idle energy P_idle[D - busy(f)]

metric_definitions.definition_quote: We collect the pass rates (TTFT%, TBT%), together with energy

slo_spec: TTFT < 400 ms for short/medium prompts, < 2 s for long prompts; TBT P95 <= 100 ms (decode); taken from Azure targets [34]. Margin-sensitivity sweep scales SLOs by 0.85x-2.0x.
load_regime: trace replay (Alibaba chat, Azure code/conversation, rate scaled to single-node capacity) and TPS/QPS sweeps
tradeoff_acknowledged: energy vs SLO compliance: <3.5% SLO violation increase; at 10 QPS pass rates drop to TTFT 88.2%; looser SLO margins save energy but raise P90 TTFT/TBT
hardware: NVIDIA DGX-A100 node (8x A100-SXM4 40GB), NVIDIA Dynamo
workloads: Alibaba chat trace, Azure code and conversation traces, microbenchmarks
extractor_notes: Energy is the objective; latency SLOs are constraints (TTFT per-request, decode at P95 TBT). Tail statistic differs by use: control loop uses P95 TBT, reporting uses P90 (microbenchmarks) and P99 TBT. Headline 'no loss of throughput'. Energy scope = GPU energy only.

tail_audit.metrics: TBT @ P95 (<= 100 ms) controller target; TTFT thresholds
